text:
ExcaliDash

Self-hosted Excalidraw workspaces with collections, real-time collaboration,
sharing, history, backups, and local or OpenID Connect authentication.

 

Self-host Excalidraw with Docker Compose,
or read the documentation at excalidash.xyz.

 Quick start

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
git clone https://github.com/ZimengXiong/ExcaliDash.git
cd ExcaliDash
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d

Open http://localhost:6767.
